c74object.name: evi.plateverb~
c74object.digest: Plate reverb based on yafr2~ with additional filtering and smoothing
c74object.description: Based on yafr2~ from MSP ('Plate reverb in the style of Griesinger' by Randy Jones). This version for evieve with dry/wet and eq added, as well as modifications for better filtering, interpolation and smoothing, and zero hold delay changes. Parameters normalised 0..1. Clickless and smooth changes possible for all parameters.

inlet.digest: Audio In Mono or Left or 1 / messages to evi.plateverb~
inlet.description: Audio In Mono or Left or channel 1, depending on 'stereo' attribute

inlet.digest: Audio In Nothing or Right or 2 / messages to evi.plateverb~
inlet.description: Audio In Nothing or Right or channel 2, depending on 'stereo' attribute

method.name: pattrstorage
method.digest: In left inlet, pattrstorage messages to evi.plateverb~
method.description: Prepending the word 'pattrstorage' allows you to send any message pattrstorage understands to the internal pattrstorage object - you can recieve pattrstorage output via the far right outlet.

attribute.name: bypass
attribute.description: Smooth bypass the reverb (1). Bypassing also CPU-mutes the internal DSP.

attribute.name: damp
attribute.description: Low..high frequency of onepole damping filter on input.

attribute.name: decay
attribute.description: One of the original parameters. Length of reverb late reflections decay. Higher values give a longer decay.

attribute.name: diffuse
attribute.description: One of the original parameters. Amount of diffuseness in the reflections. Effects times of multiple embedded delay lines.

attribute.name: dry
attribute.description: There is no 'dry/wet' in this reverb. Instead we have separate dry and wet gains. This dry gain controls the amount of gain applied to the unprocessed audio in the final mix.

attribute.name: highfrequency
attribute.description: High frequency point in Hz of the end of wet chain onepole shelving filters.

attribute.name: highgain
attribute.description: ± gain of the high shelving onpole filters. Negative values damp, positive values boost. -1..1 equates to approximately -10..10 dB.

attribute.name: lowfrequency
attribute.description: Low frequency point in Hz of the end of wet chain onepole shelving filters.

attribute.name: lowgain
attribute.description: ± gain of the low shelving onpole filters. Negative values damp, positive values boost. -1..1 equates to approximately -10..10 dB.

attribute.name: size
attribute.description: One of the original parameters. The perceived size of the reverb.

attribute.name: smoothtime
attribute.description: Set the smoothing time in ms of all the internal parameter smoothing functions.

attribute.name: stereo
attribute.description: This affects the audio inputs of the reverb (output is always stereo), notably the internal summing of the two inputs. 0=mono in (with pan control), 1=stereo in, 2=two separate channels in.

attribute.name: wet
attribute.description: There is no 'dry/wet' in this reverb. Instead we have separate dry and wet gains. This wet gain controls the amount of gain applied to the processed reverberation (late reflections) in the final mix.

c74object.discussion: For more information about other reverbs in evieve, see the 'evieve reverb' tab of the helpfile.
